name: smwgraphics-mega-man-x2-x-hunter-base
title: Mega Man X2 - X-Hunter Base 4 (Boss Rematch)
description:
The unique scenery seen in the rematch against Overdrive Ostrich, inside the X-Hunter Base, from Mega Man X2. Benefits a fair bit from parallax scrolling, which can be made by using Effect Tool.

A good fit for mechanical bases in the snow or in the desert, if you change the background colors.
